volumes.synopsis: INTO THE BLUE: After graduating from an all-boys' high school, Iori Kitahara moves away from home to go to college in a seaside town. He's eager to start a new chapter in his lifeÂ-one filled with dreams of reinventing himself, meeting beautiful girls, and reveling in his youth. But when his new abode is his uncle's dive shop, Iori's college debut doesn't turn out as glamorously as he planned! Can Iori keep himself afloat, or will the booze-fueled antics of his university's diving club wash him away?! A coming-of-age tale with beer, bums, and the Grand Blue!

FIRST TIMES: Despite swimming about as well as a sack of hammers, Iori's been drafted into Izu University's diving club. The club's beer-soaked parties bring out his inner beast, but how will he do once he's actually underwater and face-to-face with the grandeur of the sea? And swimming ability might be the least of Iori's troubles when he awakens from the club's latest drunken revel next to a beautiful woman he doesn't recognize...

RUMORS EVERYWHERE: The word around school is that Iori has a hot girlfriend--which couldn't be further from the truth. But pesky little concepts like "truth" don't matter to the male campus population: Iori's supposed good fortune has turned him into their most hated enemy, and he may not escape with his skin intact. Then, the diving club gets an unexpected new member--and she's a girl! But boy or girl, none of them will survive unscathed the greatest horror of college life: The mixer.

GO SOUTH, YOUNG MAN: Having raised their funds for the diving license boot camp, Iori and the gang finally make their way to Okinawa. But their joy is short-lived, as what awaits them there is the bane of all morons: an exam. To combat this dread, the antics of this nudity-loving diving club are only going to escalate in response!

TRADITION! TRADITION...? The Okinawa training camp continues to be a rollercoaster of shenanigans, now with a curious misunderstanding threatening to shake the dynamic of the club members' relationships... And at last, the Miyakojima tradition of otori begins! Will the springtime of youth finally grace this nude diving comedy?!

MATING SEASON: With a ticket to the Oumi Women's University school festival on the line, a fierce competition unfolds between the guys. Who will take the prize and win the right to pick up chicks and/or go to the voice actress concert?! Passionate friendship and way-too-passionate familial love go full throttle in the latest volume of the raunchy SCUBA diving comedy--minus the diving, this time!

SISTER, SISTER: On a stormy night, Iori and Chisa are left to watch the house alone. Little do they know that a passionate, libido-charged evening is about to unfold. Meanwhile, Iori's little sister, Shiori Kitahara, makes an appearance, transforming Kohei into a jealous god of destruction. Brocons, siscons, and lolicons run amok in the nude diving comedy's little-sister arc!

SUMMERTIME BREWS: Summer break is right around the corner, but first, the college club must overcome the frenzy of lectures, reports, and labs. School is a place of study, after all. But if you thought the teachers at Izu U would be normal, then you've got another thing coming! It's a treacher- ous death match against Iori's associate professor, and both pride and academic credits are on the line...

WORKING STIFF: If there's one thing college students want, it's money! After getting a job at a diner, Iori is reunited with Sakurako Busujima, the college girl he bumped heads with at the Oumi U school festival, and soon finds himself the victim of her harsh hazing and sadistic training. But then, like an angel from heaven, a pretty-faced boy appears to offer him a helping hand. Will Otoya-kun be the savior Iori so desperately needs?

KEEP DREAMING: With an actual date planned, Aina heads out into uncharted waters of a different sort with Iori. However, when it comes time to foot the bill, Iori and the club members descend into chaos... With a new diving trip in the works as well, and the usual Diving Club antics, will anyone have the time for romance?

NO MAN'S ISLAND: The diving club's excursion to an uninhabited island has left everyone in uncharted territory. While at first glance the island seems a heavenly oasis, it turns out to be a little less uninhabited than expected. Everyone is in for much more than they bargained for, and their dreamy excursion begins to feel more and more like a nightmare...

Flanked by his disapproving sister, and the unnerving distraction of a new guest in his family home, Ioriâs homecoming promises to be anything but smooth sailing to his dream diving destination.

QUESTIONS, QUESTIONS: Stumbling home after a late-night raid with the boys, Iori found himself face-to-face with Chisa, who stubbornly declared her refusal to break off their relationship.
